cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put on goggles like you. This cupboard clearly needs two specialists. You can say you need me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: These are reading glasses. I'm looking for the hinge diagram.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Close-detail work. I'll keep mine on while you find our diagram.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Found it. Hold the door upright while I screw it on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Upright, naturally. Set it where you want it, then tell me you couldn't do this without me.

reason: Replace removable confidence wrappers with an explicit copied cue, revealed misunderstanding and face-saving continuation of the same Drive pursuit.
